small_guidance: The avg_difference ~0.047 across all logits suggests the bias add in TritonLinear is being broadcast incorrectly or the lm_head weight tying is broken. GPT-2's lm_head shares weights with wte embeddings and has no bias; verify self.bias handling (it may be None) and ensure weight is not transposed incorrectly. Also check that fused_layernorm handles N=768 correctly with BLOCK_SIZE=1024 — the mean computation divides by N but x_masked is zero-padded which is fine, however verify variance uses (x-mean) only on valid lanes.
large_guidance: Redesign: (1) Drop the TritonLinear replacement on lm_head entirely since GPT-2 ties lm_head.weight to wte and the reference uses F.linear with no bias — a custom matmul there risks tying/dtype issues; keep PyTorch's lm_head and focus on Conv1D layers inside transformer blocks which are the real heavy ops. (2) Replace HuggingFace's Conv1D (used in attention qkv and mlp) with a fused Triton matmul+bias kernel, since Conv1D is just x @ W + b. (3) Ensure LayerNorm kernel uses Welford or two-pass with proper masking and matches torch.nn.LayerNorm's fp32 accumulation precisely.
